close_reason: Applied is_none_or replacement at crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs:1042. cargo clippy --tests -- -D warnings clean. cargo test --all-features clean. Workspace MSRV 1.88 vs is_none_or stable since 1.82 — in-bounds.
description:
Pre-existing clippy lint surfaced by cargo clippy -p jmap-metadata-server --all-features --tests -- -D warnings:

  --> crate-jmap-metadata-server/src/metadata.rs:1042:13
       |
  1042 |             err.get("properties").map_or(true, Value::is_null),
       |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Fix: replace with err.get("properties").is_none_or(Value::is_null).

Single-call-site mechanical refactor. is_none_or stabilized in Rust 1.82; workspace MSRV check needed but the lint suggests it is in-MSRV.

Trigger discovered during JMAP-826m.51 cleanup. Lint does not fire on the non-test clippy run, which is why earlier /review-rusty passes missed it (same root cause as JMAP-826m.51 — the prior reviewer ran clippy without --tests).
title: clippy::unnecessary_map_or at metadata.rs:1042 — use is_none_or instead of map_or(true, Value::is_null)
